basics.name: Anupam Chugh
basics.label: iOS & macOS engineer
basics.summary: iOS & macOS engineer with 11+ years shipping native mobile, computer vision, and on-device AI apps. Previously led mobile at MOBEY (Australia) and Agricx, managing editor of Better Programming, and since 2024 ships high-craft native Apple apps.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Ships 18 native Apple apps to the App Store, specializing in Swift 6 concurrency, on-device Apple Foundation Models, Vision kinematics, and local-first architecture.

work.name: Better Programming
work.summary: Directed editorial standards, author growth, and technical review across thousands of monthly engineering submissions. Led the publication to multiple HN front-page hits and millions of reads.

work.name: Agricx Lab
work.summary: Led Android engineering and shipped the company’s first iOS app, applying computer vision and image processing to agricultural quality assessment.

work.name: MOBEY (Gold Coast, Australia)
work.summary: Built on-demand delivery customer and driver apps from scratch on Android, and redesigned their native iOS applications (featured on 7 News Brisbane).

work.name: JournalDev
work.summary: Authored 300+ in-depth tutorials on Android, Core Java, and mobile architectures, and built the official Android app.
